name: HONOR Robotics D1
summary: HONOR Robotics D1, called Flash in the Chinese campaign, is a bipedal humanoid robot built around a tall, lightweight-legged body with two articulated arms and a camera-equipped upper torso. HONOR presents it as a platform for dynamic movement and autonomous navigation, with light-strip and gesture feedback for interaction. The robot was publicly presented through the 2026 Beijing E-Town humanoid half-marathon campaign. Sporting companionship is described as a future use; commercial availability has not been established.
